objective: Diagnose and repair the production Kolibri factory panel at https://kolibriai.ru/?telegram=1. Current live evidence from Mac: the static panel HTML returns 200, /api/health returns 200 with backend version 3.0.0, but /api/factory/status returns 404 even though origin/main contains backend/main.py route /api/factory/status. Classify the production deployment/proxy mismatch, perform the smallest safe repair if authorized by the existing deployment policy, keep backups/rollback evidence, and return proof that the factory panel status API works or a precise blocker if production repair cannot be completed safely.

github_source_truth.origin_main: backend/main.py contains /api/factory/status and /cluster/status routes; frontend/src/App.jsx fetches /api/factory/status

known_evidence.hypothesis: Production is serving an older/different backend or nginx/API proxy than the GitHub main backend that includes the factory status route.

required_behavior: Run read-only production diagnostics first: effective nginx/server mapping, backend process identity/version, deployed commit/build timestamp if available, and whether /api/factory/status exists in the running app.
Do not print secrets or full environment. Redact all env values and credentials.
If the fix is a deployment/proxy mismatch and a safe documented reload/restart is available, create backup/rollback evidence before applying it.
If the fix requires merging an unapproved draft PR, broad redeploy, secret change, database migration, or unknown destructive action, do not perform it; return blocked with exact next command/task.

After any safe repair, verify from the server and from public URL that /api/factory/status returns HTTP 200 with status/source/control_plane fields and that https://kolibriai.ru/?telegram=1 still returns HTML 200.
Keep product code changes in a branch/PR if code changes are needed; keep production runtime hotfix evidence separate.
acceptance: Production panel failure is classified with concrete evidence: static frontend, backend health, factory status route, deployment/proxy mapping and current running app version.
If safe repair is applied, backups/rollback path and exact changed files/services are recorded.
Public https://kolibriai.ru/api/factory/status returns HTTP 200 with factory status JSON, or result is blocked with a precise safe next task and no false success.
Public https://kolibriai.ru/?telegram=1 still returns HTTP 200 after repair or diagnostic.
No secrets, env values, cookies, database URLs or tokens appear in artifacts.
Exact five run artifacts are created.
Remote result reports task_id, server node, Russian agent display name, production status, tests, rollback/blockers and next action.
